findings.title: Media upload accepts non-image content via filename fallback
findings.status: confirmed source defect; runtime not reproduced
findings.impact: Authorized catalog editors can persist arbitrary non-image bytes under accepted image extensions, violating advertised upload type validation. No code execution, XSS or cross-tenant disclosure demonstrated.
findings.recommendation: Reject mismatched content; decode/validate allowed formats or use a narrowly justified WebP signature validator; add routed invalid-content tests.
findings.missingProof: Routed multipart negative tests and browser behavior

findings.title: Picking dispatch and inventory debit do not share a durable atomic command
findings.status: confirmed source design defect; frontend corroboration by web worker
findings.impact: Frontend sequence can commit stock debits then fail picking persistence. Repeating ordinary dispatch POSTs creates fresh ledger entries and debits again if stock suffices. Per-request tenant transactions cannot roll back previously completed requests.
findings.recommendation: One server-authoritative idempotent dispatch command with stock ledger and picking update in one transaction.
findings.missingProof: End-to-end injected failure and retry with PostgreSQL

findings.title: Integration helpers default to shared database and may skip migration errors
findings.status: confirmed test infrastructure behavior; not product isolation defect
findings.impact: Running tests without an isolated DATABASE_URL can migrate shared local database, or drop/recreate fixed test database; broad test success can hide skips.
findings.recommendation: Explicit isolated test database required, unique test DB names and fail-closed gate mode.
findings.missingProof: Worker did not execute tests; root init isolated at port 55461.

findings.title: Project listing loads all visible rows and buffers full response inside tenant transaction
findings.status: confirmed unbounded query design; scale impact unmeasured
findings.impact: Project collection has no pagination in inspected query, with a wide payload and post-query owner filtering; memory and transaction duration grow with tenant history.
findings.recommendation: Paginate and push owner filtering to authorized SQL; benchmark representative tenant sizes.
findings.missingProof: Load test/latency and response size measurements
